</div>

<div class="description">
<ul class="blockList">
<li class="blockList">
<hr>
<pre>public final class <span class="typeNameLabel">LogControl</span>
extends <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-nativebase" title="class in com.here">NativeBase</a></pre>
<div class="block"><p>This class provides functionality to enable/disable console logs as well as
 setting a custom log appender to receive log messages from the SDK. Note,
 this class will load native libraries of SDK, therefore generally it should be used
 just before SDK initialization, otherwise, it might have an unexpected performance
 impact if called not at the right time.</div>
</li>
</ul>
</div>

<a id="enableLoggingToConsole(com.here.sdk.core.engine.LogLevel)">
<!--   -->
</a>
<ul class="blockList">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>enableLoggingToConsole</h4>
<pre class="methodSignature">public static&nbsp;void&nbsp;enableLoggingToConsole&#8203;(@NonNull
                                          <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-loglevel" title="enum in com.here.sdk.core.engine">LogLevel</a>&nbsp;level)</pre>
<div class="block"><p>Enables SDK logging messages to console that can be
 viewed using logcat tool.
 Enabled by default with <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-loglevel#LOG_LEVEL_INFO"><code>LogLevel.LOG_LEVEL_INFO</code></a>.</div>
<dl>
<dt><span class="paramLabel">Parameters:</span></dt>
<dd><code>level</code> - <p>Log level.</dd>
</dl>
</li>
</ul>
<a id="disableLoggingToConsole()">
<!--   -->
</a>
<ul class="blockList">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>disableLoggingToConsole</h4>
<pre class="methodSignature">public static&nbsp;void&nbsp;disableLoggingToConsole()</pre>
<div class="block"><p>Disables SDK logging messages to console. Enabled by default with <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-loglevel#LOG_LEVEL_INFO"><code>LogLevel.LOG_LEVEL_INFO</code></a>.</div>
</li>
</ul>
<a id="setAppender(com.here.sdk.core.engine.LogLevel,com.here.sdk.core.engine.LogAppender)">
<!--   -->
</a>
<ul class="blockList">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>setAppender</h4>
<pre class="methodSignature">public static&nbsp;void&nbsp;setAppender&#8203;(@NonNull
                               <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-loglevel" title="enum in com.here.sdk.core.engine">LogLevel</a>&nbsp;level,
                               @NonNull
                               <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-logappender" title="interface in com.here.sdk.core.engine">LogAppender</a>&nbsp;appender)</pre>
<div class="block"><p>Sets a custom log appender to receive log messages from the SDK.
 This overwrites a previous custom log appender set by user.
 Note, that setting the custom appender does not disable logging to the console made by SDK,
 in order to do that use <a href="#disableLoggingToConsole()"><code>disableLoggingToConsole()</code></a> API.</div>
<dl>
<dt><span class="paramLabel">Parameters:</span></dt>
<dd><code>level</code> - <p>Log level.</dd>
<dd><code>appender</code> - <p>New log appender.</dd>
</dl>
</li>
</ul>
<a id="setAppender(com.here.sdk.core.engine.LogLevel,java.lang.String)">
<!--   -->
</a>
<ul class="blockList">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>setAppender</h4>
<pre class="methodSignature">public static&nbsp;void&nbsp;setAppender&#8203;(@NonNull
                               <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-loglevel" title="enum in com.here.sdk.core.engine">LogLevel</a>&nbsp;level,
                               @NonNull
                               java.lang.String&nbsp;path)
                        throws <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-logcontrol-invalidpathexception" title="class in com.here.sdk.core.engine">LogControl.InvalidPathException</a></pre>
<div class="block"><p>Sets a custom log appender that will write SDK log messages to a file.
 This overwrites a previous custom log appender set by user.
 Note, that setting the custom appender does not disable logging to the console made by SDK,
 in order to do that use <a href="#disableLoggingToConsole()"><code>disableLoggingToConsole()</code></a> API.</div>
<dl>
<dt><span class="paramLabel">Parameters:</span></dt>
<dd><code>level</code> - <p>Log level.</dd>
<dd><code>path</code> - <p>Absolute path to a file that the application has read/write permissions.</dd>
<dt><span class="throwsLabel">Throws:</span></dt>
<dd><code><a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-logcontrol-invalidpathexception" title="class in com.here.sdk.core.engine">LogControl.InvalidPathException</a></code> - <p><a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-logcontrol-invalidpathexception" title="class in com.here.sdk.core.engine"><code>LogControl.InvalidPathException</code></a> Indicates that the file path is invalid or not writeable.</dd>
</dl>
</li>
</ul>

</a>

<h4>removeAppender</h4>

<div class="block"><p>Removes previously added custom log appender.</div>
</li>
</ul>
